name: Warp Defenses, Mass Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level psychic 7, sorcerer/wizard 7

Targets one creature/2 levels, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as greater warp defenses except it affects multiple creatures.
